subject: Portal credential reset and audit-scope clarification for Acme SOC 2
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auditsuite.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Cc: soc2@auditsuite.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access to trust portal for Acme SOC 2 - auditor creds expired

Hi Marissa / Alice,

Our audit team attempted to log into the Redwood trust portal this morning and received an expired-invite error for the account we were using (auditor@auditsuite.com). The portal returned a 410 for the invite link. We need access to pull the artifacts listed in the scoping workbook (S3 logs, config snapshots, instance inventories).

I've attached the scoping workbook (acme-audit-scoping.xlsx) with the specific artifacts we expect to review — please confirm whether those locations are available and if we should expect any additional approvals.

Given our timeline, can you provision a new time-limited auditor credential or an alternate invite link? Ideally we get at least a 5-day read-only window. Also confirm if Redwood will provide a signed bridge letter for any gap between the report period and today.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Senior Auditor, Auditsuite
liam.oconnor@auditsuite.com
+1 415 555 0123

Attachments: acme-audit-scoping.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auditsuite.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access to trust portal for Acme SOC 2 - auditor creds expired

Hi Liam / Alice —

Thanks for the heads up and for the scoping workbook. I've looped in Vivek (security) and Jonas (account) so we can coordinate provisioning and any legal paperwork.

Quick answers and next steps:
- We can issue a time-limited auditor service account and a new portal invite. Standard window is 72 hours; we can extend to a 5-day window for this engagement if you confirm that's needed.
- Can you confirm the exact artifact paths you need from the workbook (the S3 prefixes and any speciﬁc log buckets)? We want to make sure the role has least-privilege access.
- Bridge letter: we can provide a signed bridge letter for the audit window. That requires legal sign-off and usually takes ~48 business hours after request. If you need an immediate placeholder, we can provide a statement of availability that your team can use while the signed letter is processed.

I've attached a short portal guide (soc2-portal-guide.pdf) that describes how to authenticate with a temporary service account and where to find common artifacts. Vivek — can you provision temp_audit_acme_20270510 and set the window to 5 days if feasible? Also, confirm whether the service account will be IP-restricted or require MFA.

Jonas — I'll coordinate the bridge-letter request through legal; please confirm whether Acme wants the letter to reference the audit period Oct 1, 2025 — Sep 30, 2026, or another range.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: soc2-portal-guide.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Re: Portal credential reset and audit-scope clarification for Acme SOC 2

Marissa / team —

I can provision the temporary auditor principal. Plan: create temp_audit_acme_20270510 (service account) with read-only role scoped to the S3 prefixes listed in the scoping workbook and the trust-portal read-only view. Default TTL is 72 hours; I'm ok to extend to 5 days for this engagement.

A few technical notes:
- Access will be via signed invite link that exchanges for short-lived credentials; we can bind it to specific auditor email addresses or to the service account.
- We currently do not enforce MFA on service-account invites, but we can restrict by IP range if Acme provides an egress list.
- Logs: we'll provide CloudTrail and bucket access logs under s3://acme-redwood-logs/audit/2025-10-01_to_2026-09-30 (read-only). Please confirm you need the full object list or just aggregated logs.
- Bridge letter: legal needs a completed request form (soc2-bridge-letter-request-form.pdf). Once submitted we'll route to Legal and Compliance; ~48 business hours turnaround. If Acme needs the signed letter in advance of the portal window, please flag priority.

I'll proceed to generate the invite unless you advise otherwise.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security Engineering
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Hi Marissa / Vivek / Jonas —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the following from our side:
- 5-day window is sufficient. Please provision the invite to auditor@auditsuite.com and temp_audit_acme_20270510 if that's the service-account flow you prefer.
- We need object-level access for: s3://acme-prod-logs/ (full object list) and the CloudTrail bucket you referenced.
- We'll fill out the bridge-letter request form and return it via the DocuSign link you provide — we need the signed letter to accompany our report submission.

Attached: acme-audit-scoping.xlsx (updated with exact prefixes). We'll also upload a signed NDA for any sensitive items in a follow-up if required.

If you can send the new invite link when it's ready, we'll validate access and start pulling artifacts this afternoon.

Best,
Liam
